entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Ben Salah Mosque or Ben Saleh Mosque is a 14th-century mosque in the historic medina of Marrakesh, Morocco. It is the only major surviving Marinid-era monument in Marrakesh and is notable for its fine minaret.
